fixedFacts: Album 001 contains exactly 62 numbered story pages; cover, title material, credits and end matter are additional.
Reading direction is left-to-right and the web edition is primarily a vertical long-form reader.
The Grid is an interlocking administrative system, not one magical all-purpose computer.
Golmohar's distance from Calcutta and administrative status are deliberately disputed by incompatible records.
Unit C-17, called Cecil, is a non-human municipal compliance unit and must never be depicted as a child, mascot or magically emotional robot.
Director Vale is sincere, observant and capable; their error is confidence in a model's jurisdiction, not secret malice.
The town's human practices preserve knowledge and mutual aid but also produce delay, favouritism, exclusion, exhaustion and inconsistent records.
The Grid creates real gains as well as harmful misclassification.
Album 001 ends with a hybrid trial, not destruction of the Grid or restoration of a supposedly pure past.

limits: No more than one essential background fact per panel.

The noticeboard crow exposes older corrected paper layers by taking loose clips.

visual-language.designThesis: A lively eastern-Indian municipal adventure drawn with precise silhouettes and affectionate material detail: human improvisation is warm but fallible, official systems are elegant but brittle, and both occupy the same physically credible town.

environmentLanguage.antiCollageRule: Do not assemble a generic 'Indian' setting from unrelated landmarks, festival symbols, sacred imagery, vehicles and decorative motifs. Every visible element must belong to a named location, resident activity, history layer or current plot function.
environmentLanguage.povertyRule: Repair, reuse and informal work indicate expertise and resource constraints; they are not shorthand for dirt, moral simplicity or comic backwardness.
regionalGrounding: lime plaster, exposed brick, shaded verandahs and repaired concrete appropriate to the fictional town's own history
krishnachura and other local vegetation used as geography, shade and seasonal evidence
open drains, raised thresholds, awning slopes and water marks used to explain monsoon routes
paper notices, painted boards, rails, shutters, cable loops, cycle vans, benches and practical shade devices
Bengali and English appear only through deterministic composition after language review
environmentLanguage.religionRule: A place of worship may appear only when geographically and narratively established, drawn accurately and treated as an inhabited civic neighbour, never as exotic wallpaper.
environmentLanguage.technologyRule: The Grid's hardware must remain physically installed, powered, routed and maintained. Analogue workarounds must likewise show labour, materials, capacity limits and failure points.

bengali.fontRequirement: Use a tested Bengali font with complete conjunct and vowel-mark support; never substitute pseudo-Bengali glyphs.
bengali.publicationGate: A named competent reviewer and review date are mandatory before publication.

letteringPolicy.composition: All dialogue, captions, sound effects, labels, clock numerals, device readouts, plaques and signs are composed deterministically in the publishing pipeline.

letteringPolicy.sourceOfTruth: Panel script for dialogue and captions; signage.yaml for recurring environmental text.

linework.crowds: individual silhouettes and gestures, not repeated clones
linework.machinery: straight enough to read mechanically but not sterile; repaired components retain hand-made irregularities
linework.motion: few decisive speed marks with a clear source of movement
never: indiscriminate cross-hatching that muddies small panels

negativeGuidance: no imitation of named artists, existing comics, animation studios, film franchises or copyrighted characters
no photorealism, cinematic live-action stills, 3D toy rendering or generic glossy concept art
no embedded words, letters, numerals, logos, watermarks, signatures, speech balloons or caption boxes
no pseudo-Bengali, decorative gibberish script or generated interface text
no extra, missing, fused or duplicated limbs, fingers, faces, people, animals or props
no distorted hands, broken eye-lines, impossible object grips or contradictory shadows
no character age, height, body-shape, skin-tone, hair, costume, accessory or damage drift
no unplanned duplicate characters or crowd cloning
no location mirroring that reverses established doors, tracks, counters or route directions
no costume swaps, prop swaps or suddenly repaired damage
no generic palace, temple, colonial monument, skyline or festival collage
no sepia nostalgia coding analogue practice as morally pure
no neon dystopia coding all computation as evil
no caste, class, religious, linguistic, gender, disability or regional stereotype as visual shorthand
no dirt, crowding or animal chaos added solely to signal India
no unsafe railway behaviour, animal distress or disaster spectacle as a joke
no flattening Director Vale into a villainous silhouette or Unit C-17 into a cute human child
visual-language.originalityStatement: The series uses an original, production-defined visual system. It must not imitate a named artist, living or dead, reproduce a copyrighted character, or borrow another comic's page compositions, costume language, signature marks or recurring visual jokes.

rules: Favour warm plaster, brick, cloth, paper, vegetation and skin against cooler Grid interfaces.
Do not make all analogue objects sepia or all digital objects neon; both worlds contain useful and damaged things.
Reserve high cyan saturation for active Grid states and municipal red for records, objections and human accountability.
Keep skin tones distinct within shared light; never lighten a character to improve contrast.
Use monsoon colour shifts consistently: darker masonry, more reflective ground, muted dust and brighter wet vegetation.

panelGrammar.closeUps: Use for choices, records, mechanisms and emotional pivots; prop continuity must be exact.
panelGrammar.crowdScenes: Anchor foreground, middle-ground action and consequence in depth; do not hide critical story facts in decorative density.
panelGrammar.defaultDensity: four to seven panels per story page, varied by dramatic purpose
panelGrammar.establishingPanels: Show route, entry point, active systems and where people can move before a spatial gag or breakdown.
panelGrammar.pageTurns: Place discoveries, reversals or dangerous consequences after the turn; do not depend on facing-page layouts in the vertical web reader.
panelGrammar.proceduralSequences: Use repeated angle or stable staging to make changes in state legible.
panelGrammar.reactionPanels: Earn reactions from a visible cause; use silent beats where posture carries the joke.

safeZones.captions: Preserve small, calm rectangular areas without embedding boxes or words.
safeZones.dialogue: Preserve uncluttered upper or side areas near the correct speaker without drawing balloons.
safeZones.signage: Render the sign substrate and perspective, but leave the lettering field blank for deterministic post-composition.

panelGrammar.widePanels: Use for town geography, simultaneous system effects or travel; not as empty spectacle.

hybridRules: Algorithms may recommend, but must display uncertainty and known failure conditions.
Unknown must be distinct from false.
Consequential decisions require an accessible appeal and human recourse.
Citizens must be able to correct identity and address errors.
Manual overrides must carry reasons and audit trails rather than trigger automatic punishment.
No single score may decide healthcare, education, welfare, policing, or employment.
Designers must observe actual work before digitising it.
Informal practices must be evaluated individually rather than preserved or erased as a class.
Public services must continue during network and power failure.
Accuracy claims must be published beside known failure conditions.
productionEndMatter.publicEditionText: Album One is a complete self-contained illustrated story with final panel art and deterministic lettering. This edition remains unpublished while recorded rights, Bengali-language, cultural, accessibility, responsive-reader, print, EPUB and named final editorial approvals are completed.
productionEndMatter.secondAlbumPromise: Golmohar's hybrid rules remain in force, and their new queues, appeals and arguments leave the town open to further standalone adventures without weakening this album's conclusion.

readingOrder.placement: linked on web; optional appendix in print PDF; included in EPUB
